source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Alveolar-wall destruction with permanent enlargement of distal air spaces, the pathologic pattern that defines emphysema.","B":"Abrupt pleuritic chest pain and dyspnea caused by air in the pleural space, the typical presentation of pneumothorax.","C":"Isolated exertional dyspnea without a chronic productive cough, which does not meet the classic chronic-bronchitis definition.","D":"Persistent productive cough, classically present for at least 3 months in each of 2 consecutive years after other causes have been excluded."}}
source_row.rationale: Chronic bronchitis is classically defined by persistent productive cough for at least three months per year in two consecutive years, whereas emphysema is characterized by destruction/enlargement of distal air spaces.
